This confirms H1 that HSCM positively influences the sustainability of MSMEs. Culinary MSMEs that implement HSCM indirectly increase the efficiency of their product supply chains, reduce the risk of non-halal products, and increase consumer trust, ultimately supporting the economic sustainability of their businesses (Khan et al., 2022).
